definitions.explanation: To cook food in boiling water.

notes:
{茹|ゆ}でる is an ichidan verb meaning to cook in boiling water.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: 〜を{茹|ゆ}でる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {卵|たまご}を{茹|ゆ}でる: to boil an egg
- パスタを{茹|ゆ}でる: to boil pasta
- {野菜|やさい}を{茹|ゆ}でる: to boil vegetables
- {固|かた}く{茹|ゆ}でる: to hard-boil

COMPOUNDS:
- {茹|ゆ}で{卵|たまご}: boiled egg
- {茹|ゆ}で{上|あ}がる: to finish boiling (intransitive)
- {半熟|はんじゅく}{茹|ゆ}で: soft-boiled

SIMILAR COOKING METHODS:
- {煮|に}る: to simmer, stew (longer, with flavoring)
- {蒸|む}す: to steam
- {焼|や}く: to grill, bake
